title: Angelic Worship
definition: Angelic Worship refers to the biblical teaching about God’s created angelic servants.
summary: Angelic Worship refers to the biblical teaching about God’s created angelic servants.
christFocus: Jesus is superior to angels and receives their worship.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Angelic Worship recognizes spiritual reality while keeping God, not the spiritual realm, at the center. Angels are real servants of god but never objects of worship or fascination.

Scripture speaks soberly about angels, demons, Satan, and unseen conflict, but it refuses fear, obsession, and speculation. People may ignore angels or become distracted by them.

Christ is supreme over every spiritual being and power. Jesus is superior to angels and receives their worship. Believers stand in His victory through Scripture, prayer, faith, and the power of the Holy Spirit.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Spiritual reality affects real life, but Scripture keeps the believer from fear and fascination. People may ignore angels or become distracted by them. The unseen realm must be understood under the rule of God and the victory of Christ.

It also protects against spiritual confusion. Angels are servants, demons are defeated enemies, Satan is limited, and Christ alone is worthy of trust and worship.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Let angelic truth deepen worship of God, not curiosity. Bring this doctrine into prayer, Scripture, and daily obedience. Ask the Holy Spirit to make the truth real in your thinking, desires, relationships, and next faithful step with Christ.
